Resolves #19983

Adds an opt-in hover trigger (`showOnHover_` on `Neo.toolbar.Base` and `headerActionsShowOnHover_` on `Neo.dashboard.dock.Workspace`, threaded through `LayoutAdapter.project` and `Reconciler`) that reveals a dock pane's focus-gated header actions on pointer hover while `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` reserves the full revealed action-cluster span up front so hovering into and out of a dense tab strip never shifts its overflow partition.

size-guard-growth: src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs — adds headerActionsShowOnHover_ config and afterSetHeaderActionsShowOnHover runtime propagation (#19983)

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright unit + Neural Link whitebox E2E browser execution) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-6).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/tab/HeaderActions.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockLayoutAdapter.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` (135 passed) |
| AC-2 | `src/toolbar/Base.mjs` (`showOnHover_`, `syncContextualActionsVisible`), `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` (`headerActionsShowOnHover_`), `test/playwright/unit/tab/HeaderActions.spec.mjs` |
| AC-3 | `src/toolbar/Base.mjs` (`setContextualActionMeasureReveal`), `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs` (`revealedClusterSpan` reservation), `test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/tab/HeaderActions.spec.mjs` (`showOnHover option satisfies the focus × hover × pressed truth table while staying off by default`) |
| AC-5 | `NEO_NL_PORT=8196 NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=/Users/tobiasuhlig/.neo-ai/agents/neo-gemini-julia/neomjs/neo-agent-brain npx playwright test workstation/WorkstationHeaderActionsHoverNL -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1` — 1 passed (4.0s) |
| AC-6 | `src/toolbar/Base.mjs`, `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs`, `src/dashboard/dock/projection/LayoutAdapter.mjs`, `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsFeatures.md` |

## Deltas from ticket
- `Neo.toolbar.Base#bindActionItems` binds a `pressed` config observer on non-`ActionButton` items with `showOnFocus === true` so plain `Neo.button.Base` instances re-evaluate `applyContextualActionState()` when `pressed` changes at runtime (`Neo.toolbar.ActionButton` already calls `owner.applyContextualActionState()` from `afterSetPressed`).
- `Neo.toolbar.Base#setContextualActionMeasureReveal` exposes a toolbar-owned measurement reveal (using `setSilent`, `measuringContextualActions`, and `applyContextualActionState(true)`) so `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow` reserves the revealed action-cluster span without writing to the toolbar's withhold layer (`cls`, `style`, `domWithheld`, `vdom.removeDom`).

## Test Evidence
- `NEO_NL_PORT=8196 NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=/Users/tobiasuhlig/.neo-ai/agents/neo-gemini-julia/neomjs/neo-agent-brain npx playwright test workstation/WorkstationHeaderActionsHoverNL -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1`: 1 passed (4.0s); verified default-off hover inertness, `headerActionsShowOnHover: true` reveal on real `page.mouse.move` into `heavy-tabs` (`actions.length` 2 → 6), and byte-identical `heavy-tabs` visible button partition before, during, and after hover.
- `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs -g "hovering into and out of an unfocused pane"`: 1 passed (929ms).

What needs repair is this PR's own shape: a second writer on the toolbar's withhold layer, a dead guard that doubles the gate stamp on every gated `ActionButton` press, a size-ratchet pass bought by folding unrelated code, and a test arm that leaks past its teardown. ### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #19983 (I wrote it: Fix 1–3 and six ACs; no `Design authority:` line, since it adds an option rather than calling a behavior wrong). On `dev`: `src/toolbar/Base.mjs` (`contextualActionsVisible_`, `wireFocusSubject`, and `applyContextualActionState`, whose JSDoc makes the toolbar the only owner of a withheld action's presence: "DOM presence is layered, never shared"), `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs` (`getActionItems` skips context-inactive actions because they have no box), `src/toolbar/ActionButton.mjs#afterSetPressed`, the spelling precedent `Neo.form.field.trigger.Base#showOnHover`, `LayoutAdapter`'s `autoHideRevealOnHover`, `src/main/DomEvents.mjs` (enter/leave forwarding) and `buildScripts/util/check-file-sizes.mjs`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `toolbar.Base` gains `showOnHover_` (default `false`) feeding the existing `contextualActionsVisible` gate: focus OR hover, with a pressed action exempt. A Workspace option reaches every tab header through `LayoutAdapter`, as `autoHideRevealOnHover` does. With the option on, Overflow partitions against the revealed action extent and gets that extent through the toolbar, which stays the only writer of the withhold layer. `toolbar.Base` must not learn about docks. Test isolation: the truth table on `toolbar.Base`, a partition arm on Overflow with stubbed rects, and the e2e on a 12-tab pane.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches on Fix 1 and Fix 2 (`syncContextualActionsVisible`, `showOnHover` on each projected `headerToolbar`, the `Reconciler` sync, `afterSetHeaderActionsShowOnHover`). Contradicts on ownership for Fix 3: the reveal probe in `Overflow#project` strips the inactive marker, deletes `vdom.removeDom`, flips `domWithheld` and sets `style.visibility` on the toolbar's actions, then restores them with its own copy of the gate.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres. The option is off by default, so nothing changes for anyone who does not ask for it, and the AC-3 claim survives a falsifier (Test-Evidence below).

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1: one writer for the withhold layer.** The reveal probe in `Overflow#project` writes the toolbar's withhold layer (`item.cls` minus `neo-toolbar-action-context-inactive`, `vdom.removeDom`, `domWithheld`, `style.visibility`) and restores it with its own copy of the gate (`!owner.contextualActionsVisible && !item.pressed`). It also writes `item.cls` and `item.style` reactively per action, where the toolbar's own path uses `setSilent` and one owner update. `applyContextualActionState`'s JSDoc makes the toolbar that layer's only owner, so the next change to the withhold set would have to be made twice. Required outcome: Overflow makes no direct writes to an action's `cls`, `style`, `domWithheld` or `vdom.removeDom`; the toolbar exposes the measurement reveal, and its restore re-derives state through `applyContextualActionState()`.
- [ ] **RA-2: the `pressed` observer in `bindActionItems`.** (a) Its guard `!item.isActionButton` reads a property nothing in `src/` defines (this line is its only occurrence), so it is always true. Every gated `Neo.toolbar.ActionButton`, a class this file already imports, therefore runs `applyContextualActionState()` twice per `pressed` change: once from its own `afterSetPressed` and once from this observer. The comment's `toolbar.button.Action` is that class. (b) It binds on `isFocusGatedAction(item)`, which is `false` for an action that starts `pressed: true`, and `actionBindingItems` binds each item once, so a plain button that starts pressed never gets the observer. Required: a guard on something that exists (e.g. `item instanceof ActionButton`), binding on the declared gate (`item.showOnFocus === true`), a corrected comment, and an arm for each case: a gated ActionButton press stamps the gate once, and a plain button that starts pressed is withheld after an unpress while the pane is unfocused and unhovered.

Required: revert the three unrelated folds and format the new method like its neighbours, then either declare the growth with its reason or move the propagation out of `Workspace.mjs`.
- [ ] **RA-4: orphaned JSDoc.** `wireFocusSubject`'s original block now sits directly above `afterSetShowOnHover`'s block and documents nothing; the rewritten block above `wireFocusSubject` repeats it. Required: delete the orphan.
- [ ] **RA-5: one spelling.** `LayoutAdapter.project` and the Workspace's projection options also accept `showOnHover` as an alias of `headerActionsShowOnHover`, and `DockLayoutAdapter.spec` pins it. A brand-new option ships with two names, where `autoHideRevealOnHover` has one, and the ledger row says one spelling. Required: drop the alias from both readers, the spec and the guide sentence.
- [ ] **RA-6: the body's deltas.** `Deltas from ticket: None substantive` does not hold: neither the `pressed` observer nor the alias is in #19983. Required: list whatever survives this round.
- [ ] **RA-7: the partition arm leaks.** Run alone (`-g "hovering into and out of an unfocused pane"`), it passes and then throws `TypeError: Neo.get is not a function` at `src/data/RecordFactory.mjs:375` outside any test (stack through `button/Base.mjs:373` → `menu/List.mjs:206`), so the isolated run exits red.
